page.overview:
Who is Meidani Eschede?

Meidani is pretty, with dark golden hair, blue eyes and full lips. She is tall and slim, but has a large bust which seemed overly large because of her slimness, something which gave her concern. She often wore ornaments and pins in her hair as she liked jewelry. She has a melodious voice.

She had less control over her facial expressions than most Aes Sedai, especially when angry or resentful - her eyes would narrow or blaze with anger and her mouth would pout. This was more evident because she always controlled her voice well. This only happened with personal matters though, as she always maintained perfect composure during negotiations and mediations.

Meidani is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel, a weave she learned from Egwene al'Vere.

She was only a fair-to-average negotiator and mediator. If she felt things were not progressing as they should, she would dig in her heels even if it was a detriment to finding a solution.
